queries.result: Official Egyptian Survey Authority map-service pages, the official ITDA registry-office directory, and an official Ministry of Justice notice were found. No anonymous first-party parcel-vector endpoint was verified.

officialSources.observation: Official ITDA Commercial Registry Offices Directory lists a Sohag-area Maragha Office at Low Cost Housing - Maragha. This is local registry-office evidence, not a public cadastral geometry feed.
Official Egyptian General Survey Authority page describes its historical role in maps and property books for agricultural land and built property.

Official Survey Authority digital-map page says digital maps can be requested for a specified location, scale, layers, format, and projection; this is a purchase/request workflow and does not expose anonymous parcel vectors.

Official Government Printing Authority result for Ministry of Justice Decision 6911/2025 names (Maragha Center) Maragha City and Bani Hilal among Sohag cadastral sections whose real-property-register start was postponed. The page's certificate was not accepted by the local curl client, so no TLS exception was used; the indexed first-party result was recorded only as institutional evidence.
Public official IDSC ArcGIS service metadata exposes Building, CITY, CENTER, STATE, and Equipments resources. It is administrative/building context, not an identified parcel layer.

requests.outcome: Returned service metadata. Layers were Building, CITY, CENTER, and STATE; no parcel/cadastral layer was exposed.
Returned schema identifying layer 0 as polygon Building, not parcels; no parcel identity or parcel geometry retained.
ArcGIS returned an error body (code 400 Unable to complete operation); this was not treated as evidence of absence and no geometry was retained.
Official directory HTML retrieved; Maragha Office entry confirmed.
Official Survey Authority services HTML retrieved; digital-map and cadastral-adjacent services listed, with no parcel payload.
Official digital-map procurement page retrieved; it requires a requested location/layers/format and does not provide an anonymous parcel API.

TLS certificate verification failed because the host presented a self-signed certificate. No exception was authorized or used; the first-party indexed search result was used only for the recorded institutional observation.

registryBasis: Official ITDA directory evidence identifies a Maragha registry office, and an official Ministry of Justice notice identifies Maragha City and Bani Hilal as cadastral sections in Maragha Center. This establishes local registry/cadastre context, not a public vector source or runtime admission.
